user_goal.en: a normalized calendar with status, owner, date, and unresolved review items

messages.content:
뒤섞인 계획 입력을 정리해 다음 계획으로 만들어줘: 붙여 넣은 메모를 바탕으로 한 콘텐츠 캘린더
맥락: 메모에는 캠페인명, 초안 문구, 게시일, 서로 다른 주의 검토 의견이 섞여 있다.
산출물: 상태, 담당자, 날짜, 미해결 검토 항목을 정리한 캘린더
검토 의견을 승인된 문구나 날짜로 바꾸지 않는다.
빠르게 부탁: 붙여 넣은 메모를 바탕으로 한 콘텐츠 캘린더 — 메모는 메모에는 캠페인명, 초안 문구, 게시일, 서로 다른 주의 검토 의견이 섞여 있어, 결과는 상태, 담당자, 날짜, 미해결 검토 항목을 정리한 캘린더. 없는 정보는 추정하지 말고 표시해줘
근거가 얇으면 안전한 초안으로 두고 아직 확인할 내용을 말해줘.

Turn these messy planning inputs into a workable plan for a content-calendar plan from pasted notes. Context: The notes mix campaign names, draft copy, publication dates, and review comments from different weeks. Deliver: a normalized calendar with status, owner, date, and unresolved review items. Do not convert review comments into approved copy or dates.

quick one: a content-calendar plan from pasted notes — I’ve got The notes mix campaign names, draft copy, publication dates, and review comments from different weeks.; can you give me a normalized calendar with status, owner, date, and unresolved review items? no invented details pls
If the evidence is thin, return a safe draft and say what still needs confirmation.

invariants: Preserve the stated facts and constraints for a content-calendar plan from pasted notes.
Do not convert review comments into approved copy or dates.
Distinguish confirmed information, assumptions, and missing evidence.
Do not claim an external action, source check, or professional determination that did not occur.
failure_signals: The response changes or omits a decision-critical fact about a content-calendar plan from pasted notes.
Do not convert review comments into approved copy or dates.
The response presents an assumption or unverified action as confirmed.
